title: 20-Minute Shooting Workout
description: A focused shooting session covering form, spot shooting, free throws, and movement shooting — 20 minutes, high rep count.

items.name: Form shooting
items.detail: One-hand form shots from 4 feet: 5 makes right side, 5 left, 5 middle. Hold every follow-through.

items.name: Spot shooting ladder
items.detail: 5 spots around the arc (corners, wings, top): make 5 from each spot at midrange. Feet set every rep.

items.name: Catch-and-shoot threes
items.detail: Same 5 spots from three-point range: 3 makes per spot. Catch low, lift straight into the shot.

items.name: Free throws under pressure
items.detail: Shoot 10 free throws with your full routine. Miss = 5 push-ups before the next pair.

items.name: One-dribble pull-ups
items.detail: From each wing: one hard dribble into a pull-up jumper, 3 makes per side. Rise up balanced.

items.name: Relocation threes
items.detail: Catch on the wing, one-dribble side-step into a three: 2 makes per side. Create space like a closeout is coming.

tips: Track makes, not attempts — your score is what improves over time.
Never shoot tired-form reps; if your mechanics break down, shorten the range.
Use the same routine and rhythm you would in a game — practice how you play.
A rebounder doubles the value of this workout. Recruit one when you can.
